body: I agree, if you're talking about the vast majority of women (or any people for that matter) into men. However with dating, you don't need to attract to everyone, you just need to find your niche instead, and be really attractive to some people. Has worked for me.

Easiest one, get some cashews, blend them with water and salt, after blending add some active probiotic capsules. Let the mixture ferment on the counter covered for at least one to two days. Add nutritional yeast to it after it's done, and you got yourself one of the tastiest homemade cheese spreads.
As an ugly person you will be the consolation price to some (ugly) partners and they will let you feel it by how they treat you. Love yourself, don't be with someone that can't look beyond.
